'''Gary Benjamin Schuster''' (born August 6, 1946)<ref>{{cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=l4RUAAAAMAAJ&q=%22Schuster,+Gary+Benjamin%22+1946 |title=American Men & Women of Science - Google Books |year=2003 |publisher=R.R. Bowker |isbn=9780787665296 |accessdate=2012-11-09}}</ref> was the interim president of the [[Georgia Institute of Technology]], a position he held from July 1, 2008, when former president [[G. Wayne Clough]] stepped down,<ref name="official">{{cite web|url=http://www.gatech.edu/president/biography.html |title=Biography: Interim President Gary B. Schuster, Ph.D. |publisher=Georgia Institute of Technology |accessdate=2008-10-07 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20080416140815/http://www.gatech.edu/president/biography.html |archivedate=2008-04-16 |url-status=dead }}</ref> until April 1, 2009, when [[George P. "Bud" Peterson]] was named Georgia Tech's permanent president. He still holds the office Vasser Woolley Chair of Chemistry and Biochemistry.<ref name="official"/>

==Early life and education==
Schuster earned a B.S. in Chemistry at [[Clarkson College of Technology]] in 1968, and a Ph.D. in Chemistry at [[University of Rochester]] in 1971.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.chemistry.gatech.edu/faculty/Schuster/|title=Faculty: Gary B. Schuster|publisher=Georgia Tech School of Chemistry & Biochemistry|accessdate=2008-10-07}}</ref>

==Academic life==

===University of Illinois===
Schuster was a faculty member at the [[University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign]] for 20 years.<ref name="official"/>  He also served as Head of the Department of Chemistry in the [[UIUC College of Liberal Arts and Sciences]] from 1989 to 1994.

===Georgia Tech===
Schuster became Dean of the [[Georgia Institute of Technology College of Sciences]] and professor of chemistry and biochemistry in 1994.<ref name="official"/>

He became Provost in 2006.<ref name="official"/>

He was named Interim President on April 4, 2008, and assumed the office on July 1, 2008.<ref name="official"/><ref name="cos">{{cite press release|url=http://www.gatech.edu/newsroom/release.html?id=1808 |title=Gary Schuster Named Georgia Tech Interim President |publisher=[[Georgia Institute of Technology]] |date=2008-04-04 |accessdate=2008-10-07 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20080408061413/http://www.gatech.edu/newsroom/release.html?id=1808 |archivedate=2008-04-08 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|first=Vivian |last=Fan |url=http://www.nique.net/nique/article/437 |title=Clough departs; Schuster begins interim presidency |work=[[The Technique]] |date=2008-06-27 |accessdate=2008-10-07 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20081201151144/http://www.nique.net/nique/article/437 |archivedate=December 1, 2008 }}</ref> On April 1, 2009, Schuster stepped down from the position as [[George P. "Bud" Peterson]] took over as the Institute's permanent president.
